name: TradePad_Sample
summary: This EA is a trade pad/dashboard utility that creates a visual table of symbol buttons on the chart, color-coded by trend direction (up, down, flat). It does not open trades itself; it provides an interactive panel for the trader to click symbols and monitor trend states via periodic timer updates.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个交易面板工具，在图表上创建一个可视化的品种按钮表格，按趋势方向（上涨、下跌、盘整）进行颜色编码。它本身不开仓交易，而是为交易者提供交互式面板以点击品种并通过定时器更新监控趋势状态。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非交易策略EA，而是一个交互式交易面板工具。它通过CTradePad类创建一个由行列组成的表格，每个单元格代表一个交易品种按钮。按钮颜色根据趋势状态动态变化：上涨趋势显示橄榄绿色，下跌趋势显示粉红色，盘整显示深灰色，未知趋势显示玉米丝色。入场和出场条件完全由用户手动决定，通过点击面板上的品种按钮来触发操作，EA本身不生成任何交易信号。仓位管理和资金管理也完全依赖交易者的手动决策，EA不提供任何自动化的仓位或资金管理功能。定时器每隔设定秒数刷新按钮颜色，以反映最新的趋势状态。面板支持拖拽移动，用户可以将面板拖到图表上的任意位置。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not a trading strategy EA but rather an interactive trade pad dashboard utility. It creates a table of rows and columns via the CTradePad class, where each cell represents a symbol button. Button colors change dynamically based on trend state: up-trend displays olive drab, down-trend displays hot pink, flat displays dark gray, and unknown trend displays cornsilk. Entry and exit conditions are entirely determined by the user manually — clicking symbol buttons on the panel triggers operations, and the EA itself generates no trading signals. Position sizing and money management also fully rely on the trader's manual decisions, with the EA providing no automated position or money management features. A timer refreshes button colors every configured number of seconds to reflect the latest trend state. The panel supports drag-and-drop repositioning so the user can move it anywhere on the chart.
pros: 提供直观的可视化交易面板，方便交易者快速切换和监控多个品种
支持拖拽移动面板位置，用户界面灵活可定制
通过颜色编码趋势状态，一目了然地显示市场方向
定时器自动刷新趋势颜色，保持信息实时更新
pros_en: Provides an intuitive visual trading panel for traders to quickly switch and monitor multiple symbols
Supports drag-and-drop panel repositioning with a flexible and customizable user interface
Color-codes trend states for at-a-glance market direction display
Timer automatically refreshes trend colors to keep information up-to-date
cons: EA本身不执行任何交易，仅作为辅助工具，功能单一
CreatePad函数返回值res始终为false，存在明显的逻辑缺陷
缺少错误处理机制，如CTradePad对象创建失败时无任何反馈
趋势判断逻辑封装在外部类中，无法直接评估其准确性
cons_en: The EA does not execute any trades itself, serving only as an auxiliary tool with limited single-purpose functionality
The CreatePad function always returns false (res is never set to true), indicating a clear logic defect
Lacks error handling — no feedback when CTradePad object creation fails
Trend determination logic is encapsulated in an external class, making its accuracy impossible to evaluate directly
improvements: 修复CreatePad和DeletePad函数的返回值逻辑，使其正确反映操作是否成功
添加错误处理和日志记录，当面板创建或操作失败时提供有用的反馈信息
增加面板配置的持久化功能，在重启后保留用户的面板位置和设置
improvements_en: Fix the return value logic of CreatePad and DeletePad functions to correctly reflect whether operations succeeded
Add error handling and logging to provide useful feedback when panel creation or operations fail
Add persistence for panel configuration so user's panel position and settings are preserved after restart

risk_points: 该EA不执行任何自动交易，无交易风险
外部类CTradePad的SetButtons方法可能触发交易操作，但需用户主动点击确认
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute any automated trades, posing no trading risk
The external CTradePad class's SetButtons method may trigger trade operations, but requires active user click confirmation
